Kh.bar_b_note: An appealing orange fox with a blue scarf on a flat grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade; on B the faint frames show the creature sitting upright and alert, so the faint does not read.

Zp.bar_b_note: The fleece and long horns are naturalistic and near the Stormcapra bar, but the neutral stage has no atmosphere, and on A the hit react matches standing and the faint end is a kneel with the horns raised.

Jp.bar_b_note: The Meadows terrain and sky are acceptable, but the wall is a lone thin panel standing in open grass beside a grey placeholder rock; A's braced frame, cap board and stone footing help, and B's blown-white card sinks it.

Kp.bar_b_note: The ram with the blue chest gem matches the Stormcapra style bar well, but there is no environment or light mood, and on B the hit react matches standing and the faint flips the body legs-up into a black-and-white blob.

Yu.bar_b_note: B's Tanglevolt keeps its purple lightning fur through a readable rear, crouch and collapse, close to the style bar, but the empty stage has no Valheim-class light; A's faint frames turn black-and-white and look lifted off the floor.

Tg.bar_b_note: The naturalistic snow leopard is on-style but grey on grey with little rim separation; A has no visible hit react and its faint end is an alert crouch, while B's crouch-to-collapse reads.

Xp.bar_b_note: These are the same frames as Zp: a good fleece and horn creature on a stage with no atmosphere; A's faint ends in a kneel with the horns raised, while B's faint lies flat and grounded.

Qg.bar_b_note: These are the same frames as Kp: a strong Stormcapra-class ram, but the stage has no environment light, and on B the hit react matches standing and the faint is an upturned legs-in-air body that appears lifted above its shadow.

Lp.bar_b_note: A is sunk by flat, oversaturated yellow-and-black banding and a faint where the snake rises into the air far above its shadow; B's mottled gold-black scales are naturalistic and grounded, but there is no world light around it.

Yk.bar_b_note: The elder's olive vest, green scarf and leather boots fit the Meadows palette with no oxblood, but the soft rounded face reads more animated-film than the naturalistic creature bar, and the frames are shown on a black backdrop with no world light.

top_changes.change: Run a hit-react and faint pass on every creature: a distinct recoil on every hit react (Kp/Qg B, Tg A and Zp/Xp A currently match standing), faint ends that lie on the side and touch the stage (not sitting up as on Kh B, kneeling as on Zp/Xp A or crouching as on Tg A), and no lifted bodies (Lp A, Yu A, Qg B).

Replace the homestead wall panel with a built wall that has depth: a thick timber frame with a capped top, textured wattle, plank or stone infill at mid value instead of blown white, and a stone footing set into the ground and visibly distinct from the infill.

Do a creature material and value pass: keep the underside and faint-state fur in the same palette as the body (Yu A turns black-and-white), add rim light so grey creatures (Tg) separate from the stage, and tone the Lp A snake's flat saturated yellow banding toward B's naturalistic mottling.
